description.value: Nonbiri Cafe is a Japanese-inspired specialty cafe newly opened inside the Oishii Food Hall in Richmond, BC, built around a philosophy of slow, mindful hospitality. The menu centres on hand-whisked ceremonial matcha, hojicha and black sesame lattes made with oat milk, alongside Japanese parfaits and house-made Danish pastries. Its calm aesthetic and food-hall setting make it a convenient stop for cyclists navigating Richmond's No. 3 Road corridor.
